description: Search the United States Code by subject to find which statutes are relevant — "wire fraud", "endangered species take". Returns matching section headings and their titles; call usc_section for the text. Needs a data.gov API key, which Pipeworx fronts; pass _apiKey to use your own. For a citation you already have, usc_section is keyless and more direct.

query.description: Subject matter, e.g. "wire fraud" or "clean water discharge permit".

name: usc_search
title: Usc Search
